jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(1)(C) inventory: South Hero School District, a town school district in the Grand Isle Supervisory Union (member town: South Hero) -- listed separately from the Champlain Islands UUSD; it kept its own town board. Operates K-8 (Folsom); tuitions grades 9-12.
Folsom Education & Community Center / South Hero School District (official site).

board.post_note: South Hero SD: five directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b), elected by Australian ballot with per-seat term lengths on the ballot. One seat is in an interim-appointment window to March 2027; the appointee's membership is held (see the sources).

sources.note: South Hero certified Official Return of Votes, school election March 3, 2026 (Town Clerk Naomi S. King): "SCHOOL DIRECTOR - 2 YEARS: RICHARD MONTEROSSO 460"; "SCHOOL DIRECTOR - 3 YEARS: ERIC HAMMOND 440." The 2025 town report abstract records Kathryn "Kaight" Althoff elected in March 2025 to a 2-year term (end 2027) and Timothy Maxham to a 3-year term (to 2028). Maxham's seat fell vacant effective August 1, 2026 -- the board's vacancy notice (Folsom board page) seeks an interim appointee "until March, 2027," when voters will elect a director for the final year of the term ending March 2028; Maxham is recorded ended 2026. Anna Bedard appears as the fifth name on the district's current-members list but NO fetched document names her appointment -- her membership is HELD (resolving document: the board's Aug./Sept. 2026 appointment minutes). Whitney Doremus (Vice Chair) is an incumbent since at least the March 2023 reorganization; no term end is published for her in any fetched source.

directors.name: Eric Hammond

directors.note: Ballot name Kathryn "Kaight" Althoff; elected March 2025 to a 2-year term (2025 town report abstract: 599 votes).
